The '''Fire-Eater Cells''' was a detention complex in the [[High Security Section]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] that was used to hold the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Fire-eaters]].
